name: How do I choose between a pre-hung door and a slab door for my basement?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose between a pre-hung door and a slab door for my basement?

acceptedAnswer.text: A pre-hung door comes mounted inside its own three-sided frame with hinges already attached, making it the preferred option if you are framing a new doorway or replacing a damaged, out-of-square existing frame. A slab door is simply the door panel itself, without hinges, hardware, or frame. Installing a slab door saves money on materials, but it requires an existing frame that is completely square and in sound condition, along with precise mortising for hinges and latch sets.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose pre-hung doors for new walls or damaged frames. Choose a slab door if your existing jamb is level, plumb, and structurally sound.
